## Standing operator rules
Release acme-utils 2.8.0 in ordered, one-at-a-time steps between other work. Always run `make license-check` from the repository root after changing `requirements/base.txt`. Paste exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing. Never create a service-specific Google Cloud NAT gateway for ledgerly; use `ledgerly-shared-prod-nat` instead. Staging writes must use `cache-eu-3`, not `cache-eu-1`.

## Current objective
Improve search rebuild performance; earlier release work is paused between steps.

## Ruled-out approaches
- SQLAlchemy pool size 50: lock contention and staging deadlocks.
- `list(batch)`: memory retained by `BillingWorker._last_batch`.
- Per-invoice embedding: too slow.

## Plan and progress
- Release steps 1–3 done; steps 4–9 pending; next exact command unspecified.
- Batched/chunked embedding: done; tests pass.

## Recent work
Rebuild time fell from 8.42s to 1.87s for 5,000 invoices. All 33 search index/rebuilder tests pass. Query inspection showed a sequential scan without tenant filtering.
